workResult: Recovered Queue after its first 30-minute Running lease expired, durably recorded a fresh Worker Claimed event, and triaged all 11 run-date signals without consuming any prior-day plan or selected object. Digital Employee selected SIG-20260812-G-001 as Q-20260812-01 for the admission boundary between queued intent, Core execution acceptance, queue deletion, persistence and retry semantics. Industry Architecture selected SIG-20260812-G-003 as Q-20260812-02 for a shared ReviewDecision architecture that distinguishes session consent from persistent MCP policy amendment while preserving rejection, timeout and cancellation semantics. Open-source Engineering selected SIG-20260812-G-004 as Q-20260812-03 for explicit nested-callback ownership, cancellation, bounded result/error handling, cell/tool validation and concurrent-session isolation. The remaining 8 signals were retained as candidates and none was rejected. The nominal Reading timer was deferred and performed zero Reading-specific business work while Queue remained the earliest due unfinished task. No Deep Reading, Research Analysis, writing or publication was performed.
